subject: Alternate Site Analysis and Designer Selection Schedule
overview: The MPS High School Building Committee discussed the process for analyzing alternative high school sites and received an updated timeline for procuring a project designer. The committee approved a motion to have the project manager perform a peer review of previously studied local properties to clearly document why they were ruled out.

items.title: Alternative Site Peer Review
items.summary: The committee approved a motion for the owner's project manager to perform a cursory review of previously studied city properties and create a chart detailing why those locations are not viable for the high school project.

items.title: Designer Procurement Schedule and Educational Plan
items.summary: The project management team presented an updated timeline showing that the Massachusetts School Building Authority designer selection panels have been delayed until late September and October, though the overall project remains on track for its January 2026 preliminary design submission.

items.title: Community Forum and Project Website Planning
items.summary: The committee decided to target September for a public community forum and agreed to develop a fact-based project website over the summer to keep residents informed of the building process.
